question: Which values does this picklist offer?

steps.name: values
steps.soql: SELECT Value, Label, IsActive, IsDefaultValue FROM PicklistValueInfo WHERE EntityParticle.EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = '{obj}' AND EntityParticle.QualifiedApiName = '{field}' ORDER BY Value

verdicts.say: {obj}.{field} has no picklist values, or is not a picklist.

traps: Values available per record type are set on the record type and are not shown here.
